work_or_witness: Beamdog product story and official Manual, Top Floor of the Mortuary walkthrough
description: The title-designated protagonist: a scarred, tattooed figure who has lived countless lives he cannot remember. The opening manual witness places him crawling from a slab in the Mortuary, where he can speak with Morte, Dhall, and Ei-Vene.

states_and_transformations.term: memories absent and returning to haunt him
states_and_transformations.note: Beamdog's story premise says his countless lives are not remembered and are coming back to haunt him.

cosmologies_and_realms.note: The story premise begins his journey in Sigil.
The official manual identifies it as the game-start location.

game_mechanics.note: The manual says the Nameless One cannot be moved from the first party slot, while Beamdog says his class/alignment/abilities can change through choices.

canon_status: Stable title-designated dramatic protagonist; player decisions alter build and path but do not erase the opening-witness identity.

citations.locator: The Story, lines 11–15; Pick Your Path, line 22
supports: Nameless One title, prior-life amnesia, marks, Sigil journey, and choice-dependent class/alignment/abilities

citations.locator: Walkthrough: Top Floor of the Mortuary, pp. 10–11, lines 484–499
supports: Opening Mortuary situation and direct encounters

comparison_cautions: Memories and identity are intentionally unreliable/partial at this opening point; no later revelation is used to resolve them.
Class, alignment, ability, dialogue, and ending outcomes are player-dependent and not fixed dimensions.

work_or_witness: Beamdog product story and official Manual, Top Floor of the Mortuary walkthrough
description: A floating talking skull and keeper of secrets who prods the Nameless One awake. In the opening manual walkthrough, he approaches the protagonist and can accompany him out of the Mortuary.

being_types.note: The product page calls Morte a floating skull; the manual calls him a talking skull.

roles_and_vocations.note: Directly stated in Beamdog's story premise.

cosmologies_and_realms.note: The manual places Morte in the opening Southern Preparation Room.

game_mechanics.note: The manual conditions a later scripted sequence on Morte still being with the player, so no universal later-party status is assumed.

canon_status: Named individual directly encountered in the selected opening manual witness.

supports: Morte's name, floating-skull form, keeper-of-secrets role, and act of waking the Nameless One

citations.locator: Walkthrough: Top Floor of the Mortuary, pp. 10–11, lines 485–492
supports: Morte's first approach, instruction, and conditional accompaniment

comparison_cautions: Only opening-walkthrough assistance is recorded; later party membership, dialogue, fate, and relationship branches are not universalized.

work_or_witness: Beamdog Manual, Top Floor of the Mortuary walkthrough
description: The floating figure in front of the huge book in the Mortuary Receiving Room. The official walkthrough directs the Nameless One to converse with him about the protagonist, the location, and Dustman philosophy.

being_types.note: The manual's direct encounter locator uses this descriptive wording.

affiliations.note: The manual directs a discussion with Dhall on Dustman philosophy; it does not state his membership in the selected sentence, so this is retained cautiously.

cosmologies_and_realms.note: The direct walkthrough names this room as his location.

canon_status: Named individual directly encountered in the selected opening manual witness.

citations.locator: Walkthrough: Top Floor of the Mortuary, p. 10, lines 493–496
supports: Dhall's name, Receiving Room location, and the specified conversation topics

comparison_cautions: The selected opening-manual witness supplies only encounter framing; no later identity, faction role, or outcome is inferred.
The Dustmen affiliation is moderate because the direct text specifies their philosophy as a conversation subject but does not independently label Dhall a member at this locator.

work_or_witness: Beamdog Manual, Top Floor of the Mortuary walkthrough
description: A partially blind and deaf Dustwoman at an embalming table in the Mortuary. The manual says she mistakes the protagonist for a zombie and offers a reward if he returns with requested supplies.

roles_and_vocations.note: The manual places Ei-Vene at an embalming table; it does not explicitly state an occupational title.

affiliations.note: The manual explicitly calls Ei-Vene a Dustwoman.

states_and_transformations.note: Directly stated in the manual's encounter paragraph.

cosmologies_and_realms.note: The walkthrough identifies the Embalming Room and her table there.

canon_status: Named individual directly encountered in the selected opening manual witness.

citations.locator: Walkthrough: Top Floor of the Mortuary, pp. 10–11, lines 497–500
supports: Ei-Vene's name, Dustwoman identity, partial blindness/deafness, mistaken identification, requested supplies, and conditional reward

comparison_cautions: The manual presents a conditional quest interaction; it does not establish completion, reward receipt, or a universal player choice.
The occupational label is deliberately cautious because the source provides location/task context rather than a formal title.
